method: One REALLMS call per row against the §5 standard, gated mechanically on verbatim source spans, on the rule being an operation rather than a deficiency, on the domain being a class rather than an instance, on the commitment naming a holder and a context, and on the triple having three distinct elements. Every proposal the gate accepted was then read. The family map is the reviewer's consolidation: rules that are one operation carry one atom, so the same atoms recur across rows and the emergence criterion has something to find.

order_by_denominator_magnitude.gloss: Whole-number order read off the denominator: the larger denominator names the larger fraction.

order_by_inverse_denominator_magnitude.gloss: The denominator read alone and inverted: more pieces means smaller, whatever the numerator.

order_by_component_magnitude.gloss: Both numerals read as magnitudes: larger components name the larger fraction.

order_by_inverse_component_magnitude.gloss: The same componential reading inverted: the smaller numerals name the larger fraction.

order_by_numerator_magnitude.gloss: The numerator read alone as a count.

order_by_numerator_denominator_gap.gloss: Gap thinking as an ordering: the smaller denominator-minus-numerator gap names the larger fraction. The two atoms are the condition terms smr_frac_benchmark_compare:gap_viability/3 already computes.

equate_by_numerator_denominator_gap.gloss: Gap thinking as an equivalence: equal gaps name equivalent fractions. Shares the ordering family's divergence class because it is the same class, computed by the same automaton.

equate_proximity_to_one_by_gap.gloss: Gap thinking about distance rather than order: equal gaps name equal proximity to one.

compare_fraction_names_ignoring_referent.gloss: The fraction name compared without its referent unit.

name_difference_relative_to_an_operand.gloss: The difference between two fractions named as a fraction of one operand rather than of the whole.

order_by_numerator_sum.gloss: Numerators summed across fractions with the denominators dropped.

order_by_component_sum.gloss: Numerator and denominator added together and the sums compared.

equate_by_digit_set.gloss: Two fractions treated as equivalent when the same digits appear in both.

compare_halves_by_cut_orientation.gloss: Halves of one whole compared by how the whole was cut.

share_by_repeated_halving.gloss: A sharing situation handled by halving each item once, whatever the group size.

compare_fraction_part_numerals_as_whole_.gloss: The digits right of the point read as a whole number: the larger such numeral names the larger decimal.

compare_integer_parts_then_fraction_part.gloss: The same whole-number reading with the integer parts settled first, so the divergence class is narrower than the plain reading's.

compare_written_numerals_without_scale_a.gloss: The whole numeral read as an integer with the point ignored. Both atoms are the condition terms smr_decimal_fraction_compare:decimal_order_viability/3 already computes, and decimal_action_pairs runs the same deformation.

compare_fraction_part_numerals_inverted.gloss: The same whole-number reading inverted: the larger fractional numeral names the smaller decimal.

order_by_decimal_place_count_more_is_lar.gloss: Length rather than magnitude: more decimal places names the larger value.

order_by_decimal_place_count_fewer_is_la.gloss: The length rule inverted, from the size of the terminal place unit: fewer decimal places names the larger value. Ordering by the place value of the last digit computes the same order and is the same operation.

read_a_zero_tenths_digit_as_the_smaller.gloss: A zero immediately right of the point read as a mark of smallness.

read_zero_tenths_then_fall_back_to_numer.gloss: The zero-tenths reading with a length rule behind it when no zero is present.

order_by_distance_of_the_farthest_nonzer.gloss: Magnitude read off how far a non-zero digit stands from the point, which tracks value for whole numerals and inverts below one.

compare_at_the_highest_differing_place.gloss: The sanctioned digit-by-digit comparison, which fails only where one value carries two numerals.

choose_the_nearest_by_fraction_part_nume.gloss: Proximity rather than order, judged on the fractional numerals read as whole numbers.

read_only_the_first_two_decimal_places.gloss: The money reading carried into decimals generally: two places and no more.

treat_distinct_numerals_as_distinct_numb.gloss: Numerals identified with the numbers they name, so two spellings are two numbers.

equate_only_the_expansion_the_division_a.gloss: Equality tested by whether long division for the value emits that digit string.

assert_an_expansion_falls_short_of_the_i.gloss: Any digits right of the point read as a shortfall from the next integer.

extend_a_relation_from_finite_truncation.gloss: What holds of every finite truncation carried over to the infinite expansion.

equate_a_fraction_and_its_expansion_only.gloss: Equality between a fraction and its decimal made conditional on the expansion coming to an end.

classify_a_representation_as_legitimate_.gloss: The same condition applied to whether a decimal representation counts as one at all.

classify_an_infinite_expansion_as_irrati.gloss: Irrationality read off the length of the expansion rather than its periodicity.

count_only_values_at_the_endpoints_preci.gloss: The numbers between two decimals counted at the endpoints' own precision.

multiplication_yields_a_larger_product.gloss: Multiplication read as a magnitude increase, whatever the factors.

select_division_to_obtain_a_smaller_resu.gloss: The same magnitude reading used to choose an operation: divide when the answer must be smaller.

multiply_by_repeated_addition.gloss: The product built by adding the multiplicand to itself as often as the multiplier says.

read_the_division_bar_right_to_left.gloss: a divided by b read as b divided by a.

append_the_remainder_after_the_point.gloss: The whole-number remainder written straight after the decimal point.

read_the_remainder_as_a_count_of_tenths.gloss: The remainder read as tenths whatever it was a remainder of.

carry_the_dividend_fraction_part_into_th.gloss: The dividend's point and trailing digits brought straight down into the remainder.

match_the_quotient_place_count_to_the_di.gloss: A quotient judged reasonable when it carries as many decimal places as the dividend.

classify_a_numeral_as_decimal_by_the_wri.gloss: Being a decimal treated as a property of the spelling.

write_every_decimal_to_two_places.gloss: The money convention applied to every decimal quantity.

read_the_fraction_part_as_a_count_of_sub.gloss: The digits right of the point read as a count of the next unit down.

translate_by_encoding_the_numerator.gloss: The numerator copied after the point and the denominator dropped.

translate_by_encoding_the_denominator.gloss: The denominator copied after the point and the numerator dropped.

codings.student_rule: Divide the larger number by the smaller number.

codings.student_rule: Determine the value immediately preceding a given value by subtracting 1 from it.

codings.student_rule: Assign the value of the nearest marked tick on a number line to any point placed on the line.

evidence.description_span: Attempting to find an exact, precise value for a point on a number line rather than recognizing it as an estimation task that could have multiple valid answers.
